class.name: RenderingNativeSurfaceVulkan
class.brief_description: Rendering surface backed by a Vulkan surface handle.
class.description: Wraps a native Vulkan surface for LibGodot embedding. Availability depends on Vulkan support in the engine build.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a wrapper for the Vulkan surface handle encoded in [param vulkan_surface]. Returns [code]null[/code] if Vulkan is unavailable.
